bio: Lieke Nicole-Creemers of restaurant Le Nord in Bilthoven has opened NORRA, a stylish and somewhat fashionable establishment. The atmosphere is relaxed, and she provides charming service. In the kitchen, a passionate chef serves guests both an appealing à la carte menu and a delightful set menu (including vegetarian options). French cuissons, well-considered exotic influences and playful textures add zest. For example, he uses black-legged chicken in a juicy ballotine, which is further flavoured with a cashew nut compote, a vinaigrette with balsamic vinegar, pommes fondantes and plum. Be sure to leave some room for the cheese trolley, because it is really worth it.
